verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents full query logging, with column-level replay of what each agent run read (docs-14). It also exposes the stock ClickHouse observability surface, queryable cluster-wide (docs-20), plus per-execution query stats drill-downs (docs-32), which together cover much of the 'who ran what' audit trail. Column-level lineage of where data came from (upstream provenance across tables and pipelines) is not documented; column-level read logging covers access, not lineage. Missing for 10: documented column-level data lineage/provenance, explicit user-identity audit logs beyond agent queries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
